title: OpenFang: an "Agent OS" where you spin up autonomous workers
description:
If you are tired of AI agents that just sit there waiting for you to type a prompt, you need to see OpenFang. It’s an "Agent OS" where you spin up autonomous workers—they call them "Hands"—to continuously map out research, scrape data, or generate leads on a schedule. You set the parameters, and they just run. I have to respect the developer flex here: it’s a 137,000-line Rust codebase, shipped as a single binary, with literally zero Clippy warnings. If you're on OpenClaw already, there's a one-command migration. 

https://github.com/RightNow-AI/openfang

#github #opensource
